threads.body: The test unconditionally casts `logRecordData` to `ExtendedLogRecordData`. If the test environment ever returns a non-extended implementation (e.g., due to dependency/version resolution differences), this will throw a `ClassCastException` and obscure the real failure. Add an explicit `isInstanceOf` assertion (or bind a local variable after asserting) before accessing extended-only APIs.

threads.body: This assertion block casts `logRecordData` to `ExtendedLogRecordData` without first asserting the type. If the log bridge ever returns a plain `LogRecordData` implementation (e.g., because of dependency/version alignment changes), the test will fail with a `ClassCastException` rather than a clear assertion. Add an explicit instance check before accessing `getEventName()`.
